plugins.description: Know what to post next on TikTok and Instagram Reels. Your AI agent searches Viral Swipe File, a curated library of viral videos filed by niche and format, and writes hooks and content ideas from real posts instead of a blank prompt. Each video comes with its hook, views and viral factor (its views against the account's usual), and a link to watch it.
